title: Which notifications also send an email is now a setting
description: Admin / Settings lists every kind of notification the portal sends with a switch beside it, so an owner can decide what is worth an inbox without waiting on a deploy. Everything still lands in the portal inbox either way — the switch only decides whether an email chases it.
items: Each one says what it fires on and which address it would send from
Approvals, QA hand-offs, assignments, client decisions and mentions send email today; comments and ordinary status changes do not
Changes apply to notifications written from then on — turning one on does not email a backlog
Every change is recorded, so "who turned client decisions off" has an answer
Being mentioned now emails you when you post the comment, rather than whenever the next scheduled sweep happened to run
